_comment: MOCK DATA -- illustrative values, NOT real predictions. This is the contract: Rudra's R8 step produces exactly this shape, and Vishwajeet's V7 ingest endpoint accepts exactly this shape. If either side wants to change a field, both must agree and docs/API_CONTRACT.md must be updated in the same commit.

forecast_run._comment_cutoff: input_cutoff_ts = nothing recorded after this instant was used. Required for an honest hindcast: it proves the model did not peek at the future.

rainfall._comment: fraction_of_map = forecast_24h / mean_annual_precip. 100 mm/day is a disaster in a dry valley and an ordinary day at Sohra, so absolute mm alone is not comparable across the NER.

drivers._comment: SHAP values -- each feature's contribution to this specific prediction. Needed so an officer can see WHY, not just WHAT.

predictions.counterfactual: 40 mm less antecedent rainfall and this would not have fired

data_quality._comment: Confidence band widens with distance to the nearest gauge. An honest '0.72 +/- 0.13, gauge 11 km away' is worth more to a district officer than a confident-looking 0.72.

runout.source_citation: PLACEHOLDER -- replace with the actual literature value and citation before any presentation

road_segments.name: Aizawl-Lunglei Road
road_segments._comment: chainage = distance along the road from its origin. This is how PWD engineers actually locate things -- far more useful to them than a lat/lon.

exposure._comment_wording: These are POTENTIALLY EXPOSED counts from a model runout envelope. The UI must render them as 'estimated potentially exposed', never as 'N people affected'. Roads are 'potentially affected', never 'blocked', unless a verified field report confirms blockage.

predictions.counterfactual: 30 mm less antecedent rainfall and this would not have fired
this unit fires even at 60 mm less antecedent rainfall

exposure._comment_IMPORTANT: DELIBERATE TEST CASE. probability 0.95 (very high) but exposure ZERO -> risk_level must come out LOW. This proves risk is NOT derived from probability alone. Keep this case in the demo -- a judge will ask about it, and V8's unit test asserts exactly this.
